'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Neutralizing your target is more effective without any noise, from a safe distance. The next test from Sniper is a practice in this kind of business. Get a suppressor and shoot experienced enemies from medium distances.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 5 PMCs while using a suppressed [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]]

==Rewards==
* +65,000 [[EXP]]
* 400,000 Roubles
** 420,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 460,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Vortex Razor HD Gen.2 1-6x24 30mm riflescope]]
* 1× [[Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle]] (variant PRO) at [[Jaeger]] LL4
* Unlocks purchase of [[Vortex Razor HD Gen.2 1-6x24 30mm riflescope]] at [[Jaeger]] LL4
{{quote|The enemy is absolutely helpless when they don't know where they get shot from. You did well, shooter.}}

==Guide==
Maps with a large number of open spaces where you can effectively engage at 45 m or further such as [[Woods]] and [[Shoreline]] are recommended for this quest.
